'''IceWarm''' is a Steam Workshop author who published Star Wars CCG(Decipher) 1996 Championship Decks, a table for playing [[Star Wars CCG]] in [[Tabletop Simulator]].<ref name="icewarm" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| 25 May 2014 || Published Star Wars CCG(Decipher) 1996 Championship Decks, a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table for [[Star Wars CCG]]<ref name="icewarm" />
|}
